entries.reason: no release this port's bands are measured against carries -cinematicVideoCaptureSceneMonitoringStatuses (tools/corpus/objc-inventory.lua over the 6.1.3 armv7, 16.0 arm64e and 18.0 arm64e caches), and the string type it hands back, AVCaptureSceneMonitoringStatus, is a 26.0 declaration SDK 16.4 does not make
entries.effect: an empty NSSet. The statuses report whether the current scene suits Cinematic Video ('Monitor this property ... to present a UI informing the user that they should reframe their scene', AVCaptureDevice.h:2690), and this hardware cannot capture Cinematic Video at all - every format answers NO for AVCaptureDeviceFormat.cinematicVideoCaptureSupported - so no status applies. The type's one constant, AVCaptureSceneMonitoringStatusNotEnoughLight, is a 26.0 code+lift row of its own and is NOT carried here, so nothing a caller can name is ever in the set. This row has NO host oracle: this host's own AVCaptureDevice does not answer the selector at all (measured: doesNotRecognizeSelector, and class_getInstanceMethod finds nothing), so tests/backports/host/avf-capabilities records the host column as absent and checks the port's answer alone

entries.effect: raises NSInvalidArgumentException with Apple's own reason, measured on this host as '*** -[AVCaptureDALDevice setCinematicVideoFixedFocusAtPoint:focusMode:] Not supported - use activeFormat.isCinematicVideoCaptureSupported'; the tail after the class name is what the port raises verbatim, because AVCaptureDALDevice is a private class of Apple's device-access layer while this method belongs to AVCaptureDevice. The rule is the header's own - the refusal names the format member - and the port asks exactly that member through the release's own -activeFormat, so the call is refused wherever the format's cinematicVideoCaptureSupported answers NO

A configuration can only allow what a format supports, so the port asks the release's own -device and -activeFormat and then this port's format member; with no active format - which is what 6.1.3 answers outside a running session, measured on a device, facts/AVFoundation/Release11.md - there is no configuration and the answer is NO.
